title: a-piece-names-where-its-output-lands
owner: CC owns the code, the proofs and the probe at both touched addresses. Akien owns nothing here that needs his gate: the field's absence is a measured defect, its shape follows from what the two mouths can check, and no spec choice is at issue.
intention: Give a decompose sub-problem a `writes_to` field — the addresses this piece's output lands at, whether or not they exist yet — and make it the source of aider's editable file list, demoting `uses` to read-only. Today nothing berthed says where a piece's work GOES. `uses` names survey holdings, and a holding is something the sweep FOUND, so a `build` piece's target is excluded from it by construction; `translate._files` nevertheless builds aider's editable `fnames` from `uses`, which means the apprentice is handed the files the piece READS and has to guess the file it must WRITE. The door (`write_decompose`) requires the field of new packets; the promotion judge (`judge_decompose`) checks only the field that is present, so the standing corpus is not retro-redded.
why: THE LIVED SYMPTOM, measured at the first live drive of aider-builds-a-piece piece 0: the brief handed the apprentice `venv.py` — a holding the piece names in `uses` — and the piece's actual job was to create a new general run-this-inside-the-venv verb. With no way to say where that verb goes, the model guessed `driver.py` and emitted an empty SEARCH block, which is aider's spelling of 'new file'. aider, holding driver.py open as editable, appended the new module body onto the end of it, putting `from __future__` at line 480. The edit was applied, the record said 'applied', and the repo had to be reverted by hand. That is the whole cost of the missing field at n=1, and it is a Law 1 failure at the last hop: the chain spent a stage settling how the work splits, and the module that turns a piece into a brief re-derives the target as a guess. CENSUS over the standing corpus: 51 decompose berths, 321 sub-problems, 320 carry `uses`, 0 carry any field naming an output address. The demotion of `uses` to read-only is a real tightening in its own right — today a holding a piece merely reads is handed to aider as editable, which is looser than constrain's own bounds.
traces_to: Law 1 — every answered question becomes structure; the chain answered 'where does this piece's work go' at decompose time and the answer had nowhere to berth, so the last hop re-derived it. Law 4 — a rule that matters is enforced by the schema, not by a hope that the model reads the prompt: the edit/read bound becomes aider's own fnames/read_only_fnames split, driven by a berthed field. Law 3 — the field makes a piece's target a checkable claim rather than an inference from prose.

falsifier.proves_green: prove_gate: the tester runs the touched components' proofs under isolation (`python3 -m cairn.devices.tester.cli --netns --seal --timeout 900 <dir>`) and seals a VALIDATION beside the code — verdict and seal from the same hand. Two addresses are touched and each proves at its own: cairn/devices/builder/machines/decompose/proofs/ for the door and the judge, cairn/devices/aider_shim/proofs/ for the brief. The judge's no-retro-red arm is proved against the REAL 51-berth corpus, not a fixture, because the claim is about the corpus. extra_gates: durability — committed and pushed, on the emit chokepoint; and the charter delta at each touched address pokes cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/recompile_gate.sh in the same act. kicks_back_on: a red proof routes back to build at the point of creation (CP2). Bound additionally by this node's own shape: every new check is exercised by a mutation that removes it, and a mutant that breaks syntax is not a mutant.
falsifier.proves_red: DONE when all four hold. (a) `write_decompose` REFUSES a packet in which any sub-problem lacks a non-empty `writes_to` list of non-empty in-repo addresses, with the lack named in the one-pass refusal alongside any other shape lack. (b) `judge_decompose` reds a piece whose `writes_to` names an address outside the cairn repo root or an existing DIRECTORY, and stays SILENT about a piece carrying no `writes_to` at all — proven by running the promotion-side judge over the real standing corpus of 51 berths and observing the decompose finding count UNCHANGED. (c) `translate.brief` builds aider's editable `fnames` from `writes_to` alone, puts `uses` into `read_only_fnames`, passes through a `writes_to` path that does not exist yet (a build piece's target is a file aider must CREATE — a skipped-because-unresolvable entry here would reproduce the exact defect), and refuses loudly with a re-chart message for a berth carrying no `writes_to`. (d) each new check is exercised by a mutation that removes it and a tooth that then fails. FALSIFIED IF the promotion sweep's decompose findings change against the standing corpus — a retro-red means the strictness is at the wrong mouth. WRONG-INTENT if a real piece's output genuinely cannot be named at decompose time: that would mean the split is being made before the target is knowable, and the fix would be upstream in the chain rather than a field here.
falsifier.horizon: one build for the falsifier; the watch's horizon is 10 drives whose edits land inside the declared addresses, or the first drive whose edits all land outside, whichever comes first.

children: none. The seam is one schema field, its two mouths (the door hard, the promotion judge soft), and one downstream reader (translate._files) — splitting that into children would be ceremony. The one thing that could plausibly have been a child, the chain-staleness defect, is a different seam entirely (a freshness check between the berth and the drive) and is named in distinctions_recorded for its own cast rather than nested here.

questions.a: THE TWO MOUTHS DIFFER IN STRICTNESS ON PURPOSE, AND THE CORPUS ALREADY RECORDS THAT AS A PATTERN. `_charted_packets` globs ~/.cairn/devices/chart/0/packets/decompose-*.json and keeps every packet claiming a ticket the component owns, so a hard `writes_to` requirement inside judge_decompose would red all 51 standing berths at the promotion gate — the same retro-red class as the trouble live in the inbox since 2026-08-16. The door requires the field of packets being written; the pure judge judges only what is present. survey_holdings_resolve's own docstring already names this asymmetry as deliberate rather than accidental.

`writes_to` DOES NOT HAVE TO BE A HOLDING, AND THAT IS NOT A HOLE IN THE SWEEP. decompose_composes_holdings exists because composition outside the measured inventory bypasses the sweep. A build piece creates what does not exist, so its target cannot be a holding — but the piece still has to name a MEASURED absence in `fills`, so the sweep still grounds it. What `writes_to` adds is where the answer to that absence goes, which the sweep by definition could not have found.

A `writes_to` PATH THAT DOES NOT RESOLVE MUST PASS THROUGH, NOT BE SKIPPED. `_files` today reports an unresolvable `uses` address as skipped, which is right for a holding — the piece claimed it exists. For an output address the opposite is true: a build piece's target is a file aider must CREATE, and skipping it would reproduce the exact defect this ticket fixes, at the exact function that fixes it.

NAMED AND DELIBERATELY OUT: THE CHAIN GOES STALE. Piece 0 of aider-builds-a-piece fills the measured absence 'a GENERAL run-this-inside-the-venv verb — venv.py has the pattern but keeps it private.' The decompose berth was taken at 14:05; run_in_venv went public in venv.py at 14:24 (cairn 634421d); the drive ran at 21:59 — seven and a half hours after the absence was filled. Nothing re-measures the survey between the berth and the drive, so a stale chain hands the apprentice finished work and the survival reading it produces is about nothing. That is a different seam and gets its own cast. This ticket's refusal for berths lacking the field forces a re-chart, and a re-chart incidentally re-measures — a side effect worth having, and not the fix.

PROVED 2026-08-17. MEASURED AT THE BUILD, and these are the numbers that made the two-mouth asymmetry a fact rather than a hunch: 52 standing decompose berths, 1 carrying `writes_to` (this ticket's own chain, charted after the field existed), 51 silent. A hard requirement in judge_decompose would have retro-redded all 51. The full inspector sweep after the build is 271 findings over 39 components, 0 of them decompose-sieve — identical to the pre-build baseline, so the corpus is provably untouched. Tooth 20b pins that silence as an INVARIANT with its own denominators asserted non-zero, so a green cannot be earned by reading nothing.

A TIMESTAMP COMPARISON WOULD HAVE BEEN WRONG BY HOURS WITH NOTHING ANNOUNCING IT. The probe's first design looked up the berth STANDING at the drive's time. Berth stamps are LOCAL (20260817T143716) and drive stamps are UTC (2026-08-17T20:27:31+00:00) — two vocabularies that compare cleanly and mean different things. The built design instead confirms the standing berth IS the drive's own declaration by matching the resolved `writes_to` against the `files` the record carries: an agreement on disk rather than a clock. A drive whose berth has since been re-charted reads `unknowable`, which is the honest answer and the reason this watch may need more real tickets than ten drives to reach ten countable rows.

`_inside` IS EQUALITY, NEVER CONTAINMENT — and the founding n=1 is the proof. The drive that bore this ticket declared venv.py and edited driver.py: two files in ONE folder. Any prefix, parent or package rule would have reported the very defect that bore the ticket as a pass. The same shape governs `enough`, which is deliberately asymmetric: ten agreeing drives are weak confirmation, ONE landed-outside is strong falsification, and either satisfies it.

THE WATCH STARTS AT ZERO COUNTABLE ROWS, AND THAT IS THE HONEST STATE. PROBE.carry() at the crossing reports drives=6, countable=0, counts={unknowable: 6} — 8 rows on the store collapsing to 6 drives after the dedup on (ticket, piece_index, at), every one of them predating the field and carrying its own why_unknowable sentence. The carrier names its own hole in prose. A probe that returned a green-shaped verdict here would be the hollow green its own falsifier named.

THE VOYAGE'S OWN SCORE FOR THE CHART (/sail step 9, and it is a MEASUREMENT, not an impression). Instrument: counted `tool_use` blocks in the session transcript (~/.claude/projects/-home-akien-dev-src-cairn/931efe5a-....jsonl) between the first call after the validate berth landed (UTC 20:31:37 = the berth's local 16:31:37) and this record. RESULT: 618 tool calls between the packet and done, for a 4-piece build across 3 addresses, 52 new-or-rewritten teeth, 9 mutants, 3 crossings and a verdict artifact. Read DOWNWARD as the packet's score — a good packet is one you barely had to go looking behind. Nothing counts this automatically; the count is a hand's act and the observer is owed at ticket the-builds-tool-calls-are-evidence-about-the-chart.

NAMED FALSIFICATION #1, AGAINST THE HYPOTHESIZE LEG: the berth's `piece` and `expect` are SHIFTED BY ONE relative to each other. Hypothesis 1's `piece` names arming the WATCHME probe while its `expect` describes inspect_decompose's new record entry; hypothesis 4's `piece` names the translate work while its `expect` describes the probe. The verdict door compares (piece, expect) TUPLES for coverage, so a shifted pairing berths clean and dispositions clean — the artifact is correct and the labels inside it are wrong. Falsified by: reading the berth to author the verdict, which is the first moment anything reads the two fields TOGETHER. The judge that would catch it does not exist: `hypothesize_covers_the_ranked` checks that every ranked piece appears, not that each piece's expect is ABOUT it.

NAMED FALSIFICATION #2, AGAINST THE CONSTRAIN LEG: the design wanted a `writes_to` field on the DRIVE record so the probe could read the declaration the drive was actually handed, and cairn/devices/aider_shim/driver.py is not in constrain's `in` list. The bound was honored rather than widened — the probe instead recovers the declaration by matching the standing berth's resolved `writes_to` against the `files` the record already carries — and the recovered design is arguably better (it works on drives recorded before the field existed). But the finding stands against the leg: constrain licensed the three addresses the FIX lands at and did not license the one address the fix needs to READ, and nothing in the chain asks that question. A bound that is right about writes can still be silent about reads.
